basis: J deviates from M by NET +5 d_eff toward England (M d=-59 -> J d=-54; ~+0.6pp on the 90' vector), the net of TWO OFFSETTING decomposed factors (m96 lesson: no undecomposed bundles). The small net size is the honest output of a two-sided situation, not timidity: each factor is anchored to its own data and they nearly cancel.

FACTOR 1, tactical_stylistic_matchup +10 (England): England's aerial/cross attack maps directly onto Argentina's documented aerial/cross concessions. England side: 4 headed goals (co-most at the tournament), Kane 3 headers (most of any player), 4.4 headed shots/match, 3 open-play goals from left-wing crosses, 56.7% aerial success (Opta 07-10). Argentina side: both Egypt concessions were finished from crosses off counter sequences, one a back-post header rising OVER Lisandro Martinez (Opta 07-07); ESPN 07-10 names cross defense (L.Martinez in the air) and counter vulnerability as Argentina's biggest worries; opponents converted 5 of 9 SOT through the R16 (56%). Anchored type: data-backed structural asymmetry citing both teams' actual numbers. Absorption: the mismatch is publicly written up -> residual only, magnitude conservative (+10, the m100 Manzambi size class).

FACTOR 2, injury_replacement -5 (i.e., toward Argentina): England's midfield anchor Rice is publicly UNRESOLVED for the semi after a half-time withdrawal vs Norway (sciatica-type nerve pain, hamstring structurally intact, plus illness; ESPN/Yahoo/FourFourTwo 07-11-12); Guehi is carrying a hamstring, Reece James on managed minutes, Konsa/O'Reilly came off the QF with knocks. Argentina reported no new injuries. Quansah's ban contributes ZERO marginal delta (he already missed the QF; the corrected 4-source read is a 2-match ban covering this semi). Uncertainty-weighted small discount (-5) with amend triggers registered BOTH directions at the lineup window.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED — fatigue asymmetry: both teams played 120 minutes on 7/11 with identical 4-day turnarounds. Argentina's cumulative load is heavier (two ETs + Messi at 39 playing every minute of both) but England's own ledger includes a 10-man altitude game and a longer active-injury list; rest_travel is 0.5-for-2 on materialization in this project's ledger; partially offsetting and fully public -> no deviation. Argentina's venue familiarity (played at Atlanta Stadium 7/7) noted, sub-noise.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED — 'Argentina's Elo is results-inflated' (+3.8 finishing overrun, 56% SOT-against conversion, i.e. both ends flattered): this is the m99-banned family — a systematic-divergence story usable later as a GAP EXPLANATION but never fed into J (feeding it in makes J a market simulator; m99's B1 outcome vindicated the refusal).

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED — Kane finisher premium (+2.6 tournament, positive career record): symmetric with Messi (8 goals despite two missed pens) and Argentina's own team-level overrun; m99 precedent.
CONSIDERED AND DECLINED — tempo axis: neither team bunkers by plan; no anchored low-event evidence (England's low-block problem is about opponents bunkering vs THEM, which Argentina will not do).
